name: Freschetta Gluten Free Four Cheese Pizza (Thin Rice & Tapioca Crust)
whyItWorks: Crust crafted from milled rice flour, tapioca starch, and potato starch. It bakes into a crisp, delicate crust that breaks down easily without heavy gluten dough or rough grain flours. Mild mozzarella and provolone cheese.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake directly on oven rack for 11–13 minutes. Take a lactase tablet for the cheese topping.
watchOuts: Contains real cheese; take lactase enzyme if sensitive to dairy.
